name: backpressure_retention_bound
comment: backpressure/retention-bound behavior: node constructed with max_deltas=2; a snapshot then two deltas are accepted, but a third delta_push is rejected (dropped, nothing appended) with SwmrDiagnostic{error, retention_bound_exceeded} -- the producer must SnapshotPush to continue (see dev-docs/AtomSwmrNotes.md)
